evidenceSemantics.scheduledReleaseAtUtc: Curated schedule or agency-announced standard issued time; does not certify live website posting or the time an editor inspected the source
evidenceSemantics.recordedEditorialSourceReleaseAtUtc: A time pinned in a pre-existing approved Daily/Weekly editorial receipt; the value's existence does not independently authenticate web-server posting
evidenceSemantics.exactIssuerActualPublicationAtUtc: Only populate with directly authenticated item-specific issuer publication metadata/receipt. A schedule, Daily generatedAt, Git commit or post-release owner comment is not enough
evidenceSemantics.verifiedPostReleaseClaimReceipt: A dated source-specific editorial provenance receipt, not a data redistribution or commercial rights approval

sourceRetrievalMeaning: No automated provider/API or market-data feed retrieval was performed by this Draft implementation. The issuer's publicly accessible news-release HTML was examined read-only for issue-time and factual checks.
